held_operations.reason: not offered: it reaches a caller-chosen network target that the gateway cannot confine (MIK-7788); the capability's skill scan runs and is counted

readme_token_savings.direct_tokens_per_tool_basis: Assumed, not measured. A third-party measurement of eleven MCP servers (okaneland.com/study/the-mcp-context-tax, Claude Code 2.1.204, 2026-08-09) sized tools/list schemas at about 87 to 1,150 tokens per tool, median about 231 (its per-server table divided by tool count; tokens estimated at four characters each).
